output.summary: Large deciduous trees native to Southeast and East Asia, the eastern Mediterranean and North America, sweetgums have aromatic lobed leaves and prickly woody fruits called gumballs. Their trunks exude sweet resinous sap; hardened sap, including that of American sweetgum, has long been chewed in the southern United States.
output.edibilityNote: Hardened sap can be chewed like gum; American sweetgum sap has long been used this way in the southern United States.
